text:
Situation: Cefazolin sodium has been on FDA's shortage list since 2018-11-30 and remains listed as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 128 units of the 2 g/50 mL presentation (8.9 days on hand). Corvale General holds 279 units (17.3 days). Corvale Lakeside holds 34 units (12.8 days). Other strengths at East include 330 mg/mL 3 mL SDV (19.4 days) and 225 mg/mL 2.2 mL SDV (6.5 days). The 2 g/100 mL bag at East shows 22.1 days.

Why (FDA record): FDA inspection 876911 at Hikma Farmaceutica (Portugal) S.A. (FEI 3002807173) ended 2014-03-28 and was classified OAI. A Warning Letter was issued to the same plant on 2014-10-21. Subsequent inspections at that plant in 2015-06-19, 2016-04-12, 2020-03-06, 2023-02-03, and 2023-04-21 were all classified VAI. Our 2 g/50 mL supply (NDC 00264310511) is labeled as manufactured by B. Braun Medical Inc. at a B BRAUN plant.

Our position: The shortage is ongoing. Internal redistribution can improve East's coverage quickly. External suppliers not on FDA's shortage list today are available for purchase.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 53 units of 2 g/50 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East — raises East to 13 days while General retains 17 days. Approval: pharmacy director (transfer request).
2. Purchase from Samson Medical Technologies, L.L.C. — not on FDA's shortage list today. Approval: buyer.
3. Purchase from Sandoz Inc — not on FDA's shortage list today. Approval: buyer.
4. Purchase from WG Critical Care, LLC — not on FDA's shortage list today. Approval: buyer.
5. Purchase from Apotex Corp. — not on FDA's shortage list today. Approval: buyer.

Not recommended: No other transfers or purchases at this time.
